question: __________ was the pioneer who modified the Hawaiian slide guitar to play classical ragas.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brij Bhushan Kabra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Brij Bhushan Kabra** was a pioneer in modifying the Hawaiian slide guitar to play classical ragas.
 
• He was born in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, and is renowned for his innovative approach to Indian classical music.
 
• Kabra's contribution significantly enriched the Indian classical music repertoire with the inclusion of guitar.
 
• His style brought a new dimension to Indian classical music, blending the sounds of the guitar with traditional ragas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hawaiian Slide Guitar**

 
 
• Originally used in Hawaiian music, it involves sliding a metal bar along the strings to create a smooth, gliding sound.
 
• This technique allows for a continuous range of pitches, akin to the human voice.
 
 
 
• **Indian Classical Ragas**
 
 
• Ragas are melodic frameworks for improvisation in Indian classical music.
 
• Each raga is associated with a specific time of day or season, and evokes particular emotions.
 
 
 
• **Fusion Music**
 
 
• Fusion music combines elements from different musical traditions, creating new and innovative sounds.
 
• Kabra's work represents a fusion of Western and Indian musical techniques.
 
 
 
• **Influence on Modern Indian Music**
 
 
• Brij Bhushan Kabra's integration of the guitar into Indian classical music paved the way for future musicians to experiment with new instruments and sounds.
 
• His legacy continues to inspire contemporary musicians to explore and innovate within the realm of Indian classical music.
